_comment: Hand-authored natural-language behavioural queries for Chess-Engine-in-cpp-master. Queries describe behaviour, not identifiers. Labels were assigned by reading the function source in base.json BEFORE any retrieval was run; no retrieval output, embedding, or LLM enrichment was consulted. grade 2 = the function that directly implements the described behaviour; grade 1 = a helper / closely supporting function. Single annotator (AI-assisted authoring); NOT independently reviewed by a second human. VERSION 2: the original queries are kept unchanged and additional queries were written afterwards, by reading further functions of base.json before any retrieval result for them was seen. The additional queries mostly target previously unused helper/utility functions. Still a single annotator, not independently reviewed.
